description: Restart kill mid-turn: the headless process is SIGKILLed shortly after its first tool call lands in the log (inside the 2.5s bash window), the session log must reload (torn tail discarded, interrupted turn repaired in memory), and a resume run must complete the session

checks.name: log-reloads-line-consistent
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
raw = open(os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG'], 'rb').read().decode()
lines = raw.split('\n')
torn = lines and lines[-1] != ''
if lines and lines[-1] == '': lines = lines[:-1]
else: lines = lines[:-1]  # torn final line is legal (discarded on reload)
for line in lines:
    json.loads(line)
assert lines, 'log is empty'
"

checks.name: turns-strictly-increasing
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
starts, ends = [], []
for line in open(os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']):
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e.get('type') == 'turn/start': starts.append(e['data']['turn'])
    if e.get('type') == 'turn/end': ends.append((e['data']['turn'], e['data']['reason']['kind']))
assert starts == sorted(set(starts)) and len(starts) >= 1, starts
assert ends, 'no completed turn/end after resume'
assert ends[-1][1] == 'completed', ends[-1]
assert [t for t, _ in ends] == sorted(set(t for t, _ in ends)), ends
"

checks.name: killed-turn-open-on-disk
checks.run:
python3 -c "
import json, os
counts = {'turn/start': 0, 'turn/end': 0}
for line in open(os.environ['BLAZORLY_SESSION_LOG']):
    e = json.loads(line)
    if e.get('type') in counts: counts[e['type']] += 1
assert counts['turn/start'] >= 2, counts
assert counts['turn/start'] == counts['turn/end'] + 1, counts
"
